value.reason: The handler authenticates the caller and then uses the authenticated user's email and username, but the memories query filters on `req.body.UserId` instead of `loggedInUser.data.id`. An authenticated user can therefore pass another user's ID in the request body and export that user's memories, an insecure direct object reference. The snippet is truncated, so the orders and reviews queries are not visible and could contain the same problem.
